findings.summary: Bob's top participant box renders but Alice's top participant box is missing entirely.
findings.evidence: SVG has two actor-top rects (Bob at x=200,y=0 and Alice at x=0,y=0), but asciiText's top row only shows '                  \u250c\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2510\n                  \u2502 Bob \u2502' with nothing above Alice's lifeline column, even though the lifeline '\u2502' and bottom box for Alice are both present.

findings.summary: The arrow/line for the first message (Alice->>Bob: Hello Bob!) is missing; only the label text remains.
findings.evidence: SVG has messageLine0 (data-from="Alice" data-to="Bob") connecting the two lifelines, but asciiText shows '\u2502  Hello Bob!   \u2502\n     \u2502               \u2502' with no connecting arrow line between the lifelines, unlike the second message which still has its '\u25c0\u256c\u256c...' line.

findings.summary: Both message arrows point the wrong direction, contradicting the SVG's data-from/data-to.
findings.evidence: SVG's messageLine0 is data-from="Alice" data-to="Bob" (should point right) but asciiText renders '\u2502\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u25c0' pointing left; messageLine1 is data-from="Bob" data-to="Alice" (should point left) but asciiText renders '\u25b6\u256c\u256c\u256c\u256c\u256c\u256c\u256c\u256c\u256c\u256c\u256c\u256c\u256c\u256c\u256c\u256c' pointing right.

findings.summary: Alice's top participant box label is truncated to 'Ali' instead of 'Alice'.
findings.evidence: SVG's root-0 actor-top tspan reads 'Alice', but asciiText's top box shows '\u2502 Ali   \u2502' while the bottom box for the same actor correctly shows '\u2502 Alice \u2502'.

findings.summary: Alice's top participant box label is replaced with garbled text 'Zzzzz' instead of 'Alice'.
findings.evidence: SVG's root-0 actor-top tspan reads 'Alice', but asciiText's top box shows '\u2502 Zzzzz \u2502' while the bottom box for the same actor correctly shows '\u2502 Alice \u2502'.

findings.summary: Client's top participant box is missing entirely while Server's top box renders.
findings.evidence: SVG has actor-top rects for both C (x=0) and S (x=200), but asciiText's top row only shows '                      \u250c\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2510\n                      \u2502 Server \u2502' with nothing above Client's lifeline column, even though that lifeline and the bottom Client box are present.

findings.summary: The arrow/line for the first message (C->>S: Login) is missing; only the label text remains.
findings.evidence: SVG's messageLine0 (data-from="C" data-to="S", id i0) draws a solid connecting line, but asciiText shows '\u2502        Login        \u2502\n     \u2502                     \u2502' with no arrow between the lifelines before the alt block starts.

findings.summary: All message arrows in the diagram point the wrong direction, contradicting the SVG's data-from/data-to.
findings.evidence: SVG's messageLine0 is data-from="C" data-to="S" (should point right) but asciiText renders '\u2502\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u25c0' pointing left, and all three reply messages (data-from="S" data-to="C", should point left/\u25c0) instead render as '\u25b6\u256c\u256c...' pointing right.

findings.summary: User's top actor stick-figure icon is missing entirely, unlike the matching bottom icon.
findings.evidence: SVG has a data-type="actor" stick-figure group for U at the top (actor-man actor-top, circle cy=10), but asciiText's top row starts with blank space over the User lifeline column instead of the 'O / /|\\ / \\ / User' glyph that appears at the bottom.

findings.summary: The arrow/line for the first message (U->>App: Click Login) is missing; only the label text remains.

findings.summary: All ten message arrows point the wrong direction, contradicting the SVG's data-from/data-to for every message.
findings.evidence: SVG's messageLine0 is data-from="U" data-to="App" (should point right, \u25b6) but asciiText renders '\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u25c0' pointing left; this reversal repeats for every subsequent message in the flow (e.g. the Auth->>U 'Login page' line, data-from="Auth" data-to="U", renders as '\u25b6' pointing right instead of left).
